punchline: Before one MV/8000 was sold, the Eagle team was broken up and West sent to Japan.
thirty_sec: Data General announced the MV/8000 in April 1980 in New York; before a single unit sold, the Eagle group was broken up and Tom West was sent to Japan, while engineers like Steve Wallach later founded companies of their own.
question: After the next big deadline you face, what will you have scheduled for the people who carried it?
key_contrast: A plan for the days after the launch.
